name: lifeplan landing
northStar: A personal calibration statement: completion is not calibration, and the settlement is the proof.
rules: One demonstration per viewport: the settlement sheet.
Synthetic demo data is labeled wherever it appears.
No claim without a carrier in PRODUCT.md.
Functional text floor: 11px; captions and notes: 12px.
Flat paper surfaces; rules carry structure.
do: Show the 事前/结算后 toggle as the signature interaction.
Use the real generated dashboard screenshot and its numbers.
Keep the first viewport to headline + one paragraph + two actions + the sheet.
dont: No gradient text, glass, colored left borders, or hard offset shadows.
No icon-plus-heading-plus-text card grid as the page structure.
No invented users, testimonials, stars, or benchmarks.
